parsed.rationale: Three production types in the same package `PlayerHeaderView` — `RMSProcessor.reset` (line 55), `FFTProcessor.reset` (line 183), and `AverageProcessor.reset` (line 54) — are flagged as exact function duplicates with no restraint markers (all `is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are false). The naming pattern `*Processor` strongly suggests a shared protocol already exists or should exist; the identical `reset()` body is the canonical candidate for a protocol extension default implementation. Introducing (or extending) an `AudioProcessor` protocol with a default `reset()` in a new file `AudioProcessor.swift` within the same package eliminates all three redundant implementations without changing the public API surface.
